command: docker run --rm -v $PWD:/workspace -w /workspace freqtradeorg/freqtrade:stable backtesting --config /workspace/config/btc-usdt-futures-1h-exact-1x.json --datadir /workspace/data/binance --strategy-path /workspace/strategies --strategy-list V453FreqtradeExact1x V71FreqtradeExact1x V72FreqtradeExact1x --timerange 20211105-20261105 --export trades --backtest-directory /workspace/backtests/exact-full-1h
limitations: This is native Freqtrade 1h OHLC backtesting without timeframe-detail.
Funding history is not present in the Binance OHLCV input and is neutralized to zero by the bridge.
The Binance Vision 1h input contains a 2026-10-28 gap; Freqtrade's loaded dataframe and the report retain the source data limitation.
Maker queue, order-book fills, impact, and partial fills from the original simulators are not reproduced.
